questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville gerne øve mit spanske.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det er lidt svært at finde hoved og hale i alt informationen, men det spanske universitet var hurtige til at svare på spørgsmål. På KU går det lidt langsommere, og det er lidt svært at nå at lave sin forhåndsgodkendelse inden studiestart, når det tager op til 7 uger at få godkendt, især hvis der er rettelser undervejs.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Der er let at finde en bolig i Granada. Jeg tog derned en uge inden studiestart og fandt et sted.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det er let at finde en bolig, men kvaliteten af boligen kan være virkelig dårlig. Jeg endte med at sige ja til et sted, som var meget koldt om vinteren og havde skimmelsvamp, så det er godt lige at være obs på, inden at man takker ja.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Jeg kan ikke rigtig huske, hvordan det foregik.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik alle de fag, som jeg gerne ville og nåede også at skifte undervejs, da jeg var dernede.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Der er ikke særlig mange fag til kandidater studerende og de fleste foregår på spansk, hvilket var fedt, men også utrolig krævende. Så selvom pensum måske ikke er så udfordrende, blev jeg meget overrasket over, hvor svært jeg havde ved at forstå nogle af underviserne pga. deres accent. For mit vedkommende gjorde det, at jeg var nødt til at arbejde en del ekstra for at kunne følge med i timerne.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Meget anderledes. I Granada er det meget udenadslære, og de fleste eksaminer foregår i hånden uden hjælpemidler.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: COMUNICACIÓN POLÍTICA, SISTEMA POLÍTICO Y JURÍDICO DE LA UNIÓN EUROPEA, SISTEMAS POLÍTICOS DEL MAGREB, SOCIOLOGÍA DE LA POBLACIÓN Y DE LAS MIGRACIONES, TEORÍA DE LA DEMOCRACIA:GÉNERO E INTERCULTURALIDAD

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: SISTEMA POLÍTICO Y JURÍDICO DE LA UNIÓN EUROPE var et virkelig fedt fag, men mest pga. af underviseren.

What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Mange sports aktiviteter og kulturelle arrangementer

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg gik til salsa, hvilket var vildt sjovt.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tage ud og besøge de andre spanske byer.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det gik stille og roligt. Det sværeste var at vende sig til at have undervisning til kl. 22 om aftenen.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: I starten skulle jeg lige vende mig til at have undervisning sent på dagen.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: At dagen er rigtig lang i Spanien, selvom du først er færdig med undervisning kl. 22, er der stadig masser af tid til at tage ud og opleve byen.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Måden de har eksaminer på er svære ift. at det er på spansk (da du ikke må bruge hjælpemidler)
2. Eksaminerne ligger ret tæt op af hinanden, så man skal lidt studere det hele på en gang
3. Granada er en fantastisk by og for mit vedkommende det perfekte sted at tage på udveksling.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At møde så mange dejlige mennesker fra hele verden.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Eksamensperioden. Jeg havde svært ved at forstå formen, rutinerne og pointsystemet, så det stressede mig lidt.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
